# Income Tax Rates (所得税の税率)

## Tax Year 2024

| Taxable Income | Tax Rate | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 1,950,000 JPY | 5% | 0 JPY |
| 1,950,001 to 3,300,000 JPY | 10% | 97,500 JPY |
| 3,300,001 to 6,950,000 JPY | 20% | 427,500 JPY |
| 6,950,001 to 9,000,000 JPY | 23% | 636,000 JPY |
| 9,000,001 to 18,000,000 JPY | 33% | 1,536,000 JPY |
| 18,000,001 to 40,000,000 JPY | 40% | 2,796,000 JPY |
| Over 40,000,000 JPY | 45% | 4,796,000 JPY |
